package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type AssignCourseInput struct {
	StudentID         string
	CourseID          string
	PlanningRequestID string
	AssignedBy        string
	IdempotencyKey    string
}

type AssignCourse struct {
	Assignments repository.CourseAssignmentRepository
	Clock       LearningJourneyClock
	IDs         LearningJourneyIDGenerator
}

func (useCase AssignCourse) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input AssignCourseInput,
) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, bool, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.AssignedBy = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.AssignedBy))
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	if useCase.Assignments == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || useCase.IDs == nil ||
		!validStudentUUID(input.StudentID) || !validStudentUUID(input.CourseID) ||
		!validStudentUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) || !validStudentUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) ||
		input.AssignedBy != domain.CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner {
		return domain.StudentCourseAssignment{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	assignment, err := domain.NormalizeStudentCourseAssignment(domain.StudentCourseAssignment{
		ID: useCase.IDs.NewID(), StudentID: input.StudentID, CourseID: input.CourseID,
		Status: domain.CourseAssignmentAssigned, AssignedBy: input.AssignedBy,
		InitialPlanningRequestID: input.PlanningRequestID, AssignedAt: useCase.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentCourseAssignment{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestHash := courseAssignmentRequestHash(input)
	return useCase.Assignments.Assign(ctx, assignment, domain.CourseAssignmentRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: input.IdempotencyKey, PlanningRequestID: input.PlanningRequestID,
		RequestHash: requestHash, AssignmentID: assignment.ID,
	})
}

type GetStudentCourses struct {
	Assignments repository.CourseAssignmentRepository
}

func (useCase GetStudentCourses) List(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
) ([]domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Assignments == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Assignments.List(ctx, studentID)
}

func (useCase GetStudentCourses) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	courseID string,
) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	courseID = strings.TrimSpace(courseID)
	if useCase.Assignments == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(courseID) {
		return domain.StudentCourseAssignment{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Assignments.Get(ctx, studentID, courseID)
}

func (useCase GetStudentCourses) CanAccessCourse(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	courseID string,
) (bool, error) {
	assignment, err := useCase.Get(ctx, studentID, courseID)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	switch assignment.Status {
	case domain.CourseAssignmentAssigned, domain.CourseAssignmentInProgress,
		domain.CourseAssignmentPaused, domain.CourseAssignmentCompleted:
		return true, nil
	default:
		return false, nil
	}
}

func courseAssignmentRequestHash(input AssignCourseInput) string {
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join([]string{
		input.StudentID, input.CourseID, input.PlanningRequestID, input.AssignedBy,
	}, "\x00")))
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}
